# Who holds the copyright on the crates that ship no licence file, which
# cargo-about renders with "Copyright (c) <year> <copyright holders>".
# From the upstream repository's licence file where it has one, otherwise
# the manifest's authors. Pattern :: text; the first match wins.
# tools/third-party/notices.py stops on a crate that matches nothing.
bitflagset :: the bitflagset authors, https://github.com/youknowone/bitflagset (no holder named in the package or a licence file upstream)
blake2?_simd :: Copyright (c) 2018 Jack O'Connor
block2 :: Mads Marquart and the objc2 contributors
dispatch2 :: Mads Marquart, Mary and the objc2 contributors
objc2* :: Mads Marquart and the objc2 contributors
chrono :: Copyright (c) 2014, Kang Seonghoon, and the chrono contributors
libffi :: Copyright (c) 2026 libffi-rs contributors; Jesse A. Tov
libm :: the Rust compiler-builtins authors (Alex Crichton, Amanieu d'Antras, Jorge Aparicio and others); parts ported from musl, see musl's notice
quote-use* :: Copyright (c) Roland Fredenhagen
rustpython-ruff_* :: Copyright (c) 2022 Charles Marsh; RustPython's fork of Ruff
rustpython-* :: Copyright (c) 2026 RustPython Team
windows* :: Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation
xz-core :: no holder named in the package; transpiled from liblzma of XZ Utils (0BSD) with c2rust
xz-sys :: no holder named in the package; the API layer over xz-core
